verdict.rationale: FreshBooks Bill Pay documents bill capture (forwarding bills, or uploading or photographing them so Bill Pay 'reads the details and recreates the bill'). It also documents scheduling and executing vendor payments by ACH or check, with due-date tracking and payment status from created to paid. Nothing in the pack shows bills being routed for approval, a core part of the story. The API surface lists Bills and Bill Vendors (beta) but nothing approval-related. Missing for 10: bill approval routing/workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration of the capture-to-payment flow.
